listing.name: Arx Fatalis (Arx Libertatis)
listing.summary: Use a complete Arx Libertatis 1.2.1 Windows player prepared with your own supported Arx Fatalis or permitted demo files. Keep the actual data, saves and configuration locations; you and the project manage this external copy and its updates.

steps.title: Keep the complete native Arx player
steps.instruction: Use an already permitted complete Arx Libertatis1.2.1 Windows installation or ZIP, including compatible libraries/resources. Select arx.exe directly, not arxtool, arxsavetool, arxunpak, a crash reporter or installer. Normal GUI entry runs the game in that process; a diagnostic/crash helper is a separate upstream process and is not adopted by Core.

steps.title: Finish upstream data preparation first
steps.instruction: Use your own permitted supported full Arx Fatalis data or separately permitted demo with the upstream preparation path for that edition/language. The reviewed installer script distinguishes CD/ISO preparation needing1.21 patch data, already installed/GOG alternatives, Japanese and demo branches; do not mix their data sets or assume one minimal PAK list. Finish the upstream setup and normal start/quit before registration. Core invokes no extraction/patch/helper and grants no original/demo asset rights.

steps.title: Preserve the established directory choices
steps.instruction: Use the actual prepared working directory and existing supported literal data/user/config arguments. Actual Windows Saved Games/Arx Libertatis (older Documents/My Games fallback), registry UserDir/DataDir, config dir, executable/data search and custom/environment roots can differ. Keep established --data-dir/--user-dir/--config-dir values where used. The documented --no-data-dir --user-dir=. --config-dir=. portable combination is an existing upstream option, not a command to move your profile or force a new one. Review intent/consent and choose Play separately.

steps.title: Update the game and remove its registration
steps.instruction: Close every running copy before changing external files. You manage setup, game replacement, profile changes, data migration and recovery. Keep the working game version and every data folder, update it with the project’s tools, then review and select the changed executable before choosing Play. Portcove monitors only the process you selected and agreed to launch. It does not prevent other copies from running, restrict file access or take over unrelated helpers or replacement processes. Removing the registration leaves external files in place. This route does not offer Portcove downloads, setup, updates, backups, rollback, data migration or deletion.

warnings: Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use. These instructions do not establish permission for the original game or other components, or confirm the resulting game files.
These instructions do not confirm gameplay, saving, mods, network play, physical controls or behavior on other platforms.
Before updating the game, keep a recoverable copy of its working files and every location containing saved data. Another game folder may use the same profile.

First use can lowercase used files in the user tree; startup prunes old crash reports and writes logs. Keep a recoverable old copy before those upstream operations. No actual save roundtrip or harmless read-only startup is promised. Engine GPL3+ and component/additional terms remain separate from original data rights.
